card.changed: Chained hops no longer stack speed without limit. A jump still leans the way you're going, fully up to Bob's top rolling speed, so a single jump from a roll goes as far as before; past top speed the lean fades. Hopping is now about one and a half times as fast as rolling, where it was more than twice.
try: Roll right through the hills and along the flat (hold right).
Press R, then do the same stretch hopping: tap jump over and over while holding right.
Jump the gaps and the lava as you normally would.
lookFor: Whether hopping still feels worth it, but not the only way to move.
Whether single jumps over things feel the same as before.
known: The search bot's numbers: rolling about 445 cells in 8 s; the best hopping rhythm about 680 (it was about 1250).
questions: Is hopping slowed the right amount: too little, right, or too much?
Do single jumps feel the same as before?
